lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Trinidad and Tobago through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 24% of estimated total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 5 years and minimal recent updates (0% in last 6 months). Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) with standardized OSM schema attributes.
